check('runs of spaces', lambda: squash("a   b"), 'a b')
check('tabs and newlines', lambda: squash(" a\tb\n c "), 'a b c')
check('empty', lambda: squash(""), '')
check('only spaces', lambda: squash("   "), '')
check('single word', lambda: squash("x"), 'x')
check('unicode spaces', lambda: squash("a\u00a0\u2003b"), 'a b')

check('title', lambda: slugify("Orders & Returns 2026"), 'orders-returns-2026')
check('accents', lambda: slugify("Crème Brûlée"), 'creme-brulee')
check('punctuation only', lambda: slugify("!!!"), '')
check('already a slug', lambda: slugify("daily-orders"), 'daily-orders')
check('leading and trailing junk', lambda: slugify("  --Hello, World!--  "), 'hello-world')
check('empty', lambda: slugify(""), '')

check('classic sentence', lambda: is_palindrome("A man, a plan, a canal: Panama"), True)
check('not a palindrome', lambda: is_palindrome("race a car"), False)
check('empty', lambda: is_palindrome(""), True)
check('single character', lambda: is_palindrome("x"), True)
check('digits', lambda: is_palindrome("12 21"), True)
check('case only', lambda: is_palindrome("Aa"), True)

check('normal', lambda: mask_email("ada@example.com"), 'a***@example.com')
check('one-letter user', lambda: mask_email("a@x.io"), 'a***@x.io')
check('no at sign', lambda: mask_email("not-an-email"), 'not-an-email')
check('at sign in user part', lambda: mask_email("a@b@corp.io"), 'a***@corp.io')
check('empty user', lambda: mask_email("@x.io"), '@x.io')
check('subdomain', lambda: mask_email("grace.h@mail.corp.io"), 'g***@mail.corp.io')

check('two pairs', lambda: parse_pairs("host=db;port=5432"), {'host': 'db', 'port': '5432'})
check('spaces', lambda: parse_pairs(" a = 1 ; b=2 "), {'a': '1', 'b': '2'})
check('value with equals', lambda: parse_pairs("q=a=b"), {'q': 'a=b'})
check('empty items', lambda: parse_pairs(";a=1;;"), {'a': '1'})
check('empty', lambda: parse_pairs(""), {})
check('key without value', lambda: parse_pairs("flag"), {'flag': ''})

check('full line', lambda: parse_log("2026-01-05 09:15:00 ERROR order=42 latency=120ms"), {'date': '2026-01-05', 'level': 'ERROR', 'order': '42', 'latency': '120ms'})
check('no pairs', lambda: parse_log("2026-01-05 09:15:00 INFO started"), {'date': '2026-01-05', 'level': 'INFO'})
check('not a log line', lambda: parse_log("hello"), None)
check('lowercase level is rejected', lambda: parse_log("2026-01-05 09:15:00 info x=1"), None)
check('pairs keep order', lambda: list(parse_log("2026-01-05 09:15:00 WARN b=2 a=1")), ['date', 'level', 'b', 'a'])
check('empty', lambda: parse_log(""), None)

check('valid', lambda: valid_sku("SKU-4001"), True)
check('too short', lambda: valid_sku("SKU-40"), False)
check('extra suffix', lambda: valid_sku("SKU-4001x"), False)
check('lowercase', lambda: valid_sku("sku-4001"), False)
check('embedded', lambda: valid_sku("x SKU-4001"), False)
check('unicode digits', lambda: valid_sku("SKU-١٢٣٤"), True)

check('two tags', lambda: hashtags("New #Release of #spark"), ['release', 'spark'])
check('duplicates in different case', lambda: hashtags("#Data #data #DATA"), ['data'])
check('none', lambda: hashtags("no tags"), [])
check('underscores', lambda: hashtags("#big_data!"), ['big_data'])
check('adjacent', lambda: hashtags("#a#b"), ['a', 'b'])
check('empty', lambda: hashtags(""), [])

check('runs', lambda: rle("aaabcc"), 'a3b1c2')
check('empty', lambda: rle(""), '')
check('single', lambda: rle("x"), 'x1')
check('no repeats', lambda: rle("abc"), 'a1b1c1')
check('long run', lambda: rle("z" * 12), 'z12')
check('same char separated', lambda: rle("aabaa"), 'a2b1a2')

check('sentence', lambda: reverse_words("the sky is blue"), 'blue is sky the')
check('extra spaces', lambda: reverse_words("  hello   world "), 'world hello')
check('empty', lambda: reverse_words(""), '')
check('one word', lambda: reverse_words("x"), 'x')
check('punctuation stays', lambda: reverse_words("a, b."), 'b. a,')
check('tabs', lambda: reverse_words("a\tb"), 'b a')

check('typical', lambda: report_row("orders", 1234567, 0.256), 'orders      | 1,234,567|  25.6%')
check('long name truncated', lambda: report_row("order_items_daily", 5, 1.0), 'order_items_|         5| 100.0%')
check('zero', lambda: report_row("x", 0, 0.0), 'x           |         0|   0.0%')
check('small share', lambda: report_row("y", 12, 0.0004), 'y           |        12|   0.0%')
check('exact width', lambda: report_row("abcdefghijkl", 1000, 0.5), 'abcdefghijkl|     1,000|  50.0%')
check('length is fixed', lambda: len(report_row("a", 1, 0.1)), 31)

check('utf-8', lambda: decode_text("café".encode("utf-8")), 'café')
check('bom removed', lambda: decode_text("\ufeffid".encode("utf-8")), 'id')
check('cp1252 fallback', lambda: decode_text("café".encode("cp1252")), 'café')
check('euro sign in cp1252', lambda: decode_text(b"\x80 5"), '€ 5')
check('empty', lambda: decode_text(b""), '')
check('ascii', lambda: decode_text(b"plain"), 'plain')

check('one date', lambda: iso_dates("due 05/01/2026"), 'due 2026-01-05')
check('two dates', lambda: iso_dates("03/01/2026 to 31/12/2026"), '2026-01-03 to 2026-12-31')
check('no dates', lambda: iso_dates("none"), 'none')
check('part of a longer number', lambda: iso_dates("105/01/20260"), '105/01/20260')
check('adjacent text', lambda: iso_dates("on05/01/2026."), 'on2026-01-05.')
check('empty', lambda: iso_dates(""), '')

check('accents and case', lambda: name_key("José  Müller") == name_key("jose muller"), True)
check('composed vs decomposed', lambda: name_key("caf\u00e9") == name_key("cafe\u0301"), True)
check('sharp s', lambda: name_key("Straße"), 'strasse')
check('ligature', lambda: name_key("ﬁnance"), 'finance')
check('different names differ', lambda: name_key("Ana") == name_key("Anna"), False)
check('value', lambda: name_key("  Zoë  "), 'zoe')
